{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Check how many rows have -999 in biomarker_baseline
n_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Output the findings
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicates)}')
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {n_neg999}')"}
